The Don't "A bare Button" adds that without those modes "it's gold and size M, too loud for a header." The evidence agrees (gold Primary, size M). The example drops the TILE modes that the guide's In context sets.

dismissed.why: The guide and the evidence describe the 20 October build (0.1.78-c7d3348); the installed package is 0.1.78-dbe0e02, which the reviewer can’t see. There, SummaryTile.tsx lines 26–29 set ACTION_SLOT_DEFAULTS { AppearanceBrand: ‘Secondary’, ‘Button / Size’: ‘S’ }, line 175 merges the tile’s modes over them, and line 179 clones children with that, so a Button in children with no modes on the tile is purple and size S, as the guide’s TILE modes made it on c7d3348; setting those modes on the tile now only repeats the default, which the building rules leave out. The guide’s sentences to the contrary are the stale ones the entry’s human flag lists (#352).
